item.visible: [!String.IsEmpty(ListItem.Property(kofin.id)) | [!String.IsEmpty(ListItem.DBID) + [String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,movie) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,episode) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,musicvideo) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,tvshow) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,season) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,set) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,song) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,album) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,artist)]] | [String.IsEqual(Container.FolderPath,library://music/kofin/) + String.Contains(ListItem.FileNameAndPath,library://music/kofin/kofinmusic)]]

extension.news: v0.93.0 - Movie versions and extras in the API build: a movie's alternate versions and special features are files in its folder. Kodi imports a version as a movie of its own, to be grouped in the Versions Manager, and the extras under the movie. - Kodi's "Ignore video extras on scan" is turned off once for the extras import, with a notice. - Library nodes and smart playlists for the synced video libraries, and Jellyfin playlists under Videos → Playlists → Kofin and Music → Playlists → Kofin; one setting on the Sync tab switches all of it. - Kodi's own Movies and TV shows nodes are kept beside Kofin's, so the home screen's categories rows stay. Restart Kodi once after upgrading. - The full cast shows in a movie's information dialog again: every movie folder carries its scraper binding. - Downloads in the API build: a downloaded item plays from disk however it is reached, carries the badge and the Kofin Downloads tag, and nothing of Kodi's rows is moved. - What the stock interfaces cannot do, grouping a movie's versions, is published as a request document for a companion add-on. - Every path that publishes a movie carries its special features, so Clean databases removes only files the server no longer lists.
